name: deck-kit
description: Plan and build presenter-grade HTML slide decks (workshop / lecture / talk) in two skills: deck-plan turns any source — thesis, outline, article, script — into a reviewed slide plan (.planning/deck-spec.md with one archetype·title·message·source line per slide), and deck-build generates the deck slide-by-slide through a Socratic dialog (never batch), from 24 slide archetypes (cover, quote, phase, terminal-demo, wheel, hook, thesis, learning-objectives, recap, …) on a frozen cyberpunk design-token system. Every deck must pass 4 independent validation gates before it ships: static structure, design-token integrity, HTTP smoke, and Playwright visual rendering at 1920×1080 with per-slide screenshots. Decks are plain HTML files — python3 -m http.server and present with keyboard nav and presenter mode.
